fields.label: Backup Pool
fields.help: URL to the backup target pool.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Failover Ratio
fields.help: Ratio (0 to 1) of failed nodes before using the backup pool (which must also be set).

fields.label: Health Checks
fields.help: List of zero or one health check name or self_link.

fields.label: Instances
fields.help: List of instances in the pool.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A unique name for the resource, required by GCE.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
